messages.snippet: Charlotte, Hargrove has returned their mark-up. They opened by pushing the cap from our 50 to 30 per
messages.subject: Project Relay - SPA: recommended compromise & cap sign-off
messages.plaintextBody:
Charlotte,

Hargrove has returned their mark-up. They opened by pushing the cap from our 50 to 30 per cent., cutting survival to 18 months and the non-compete to 12, and loading up the MAC and leakage carve-outs. Our recommended landing, which we believe they will accept:

- General warranty cap 40 per cent. of Consideration (overall cap stays 100 per cent.).
- Survival 21 months, matched to the escrow retention period.
- Non-compete 18 months; non-solicit 24 months.
- De minimis GBP 35,000; basket GBP 450,000.
- MAC: give general-economic and industry carve-outs; refuse the change-in-law carve-out.
- Leakage: give transaction-bonus and adviser-fee carve-outs; refuse the pre-completion tax-distribution one.
- Escrow GBP 3,800,000 (10 per cent.) for 21 months.
- W&I being bound to backstop the warranties (limit to confirm shortly).

The one point needing your explicit sign-off is the cap moving from 50 to 40 per cent. Grateful for approval.

Best,
Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

Given the W&I policy will sit behind the warranties, we're comfortable at a 40 per cent. cap and the 21-month survival - the insurance is doing the heavy lifting, not the sellers' balance sheet. Charlotte
